mapper.update: UPDATE workflow_variables SET last_accessed_at = #{accessTime}, access_count = COALESCE(access_count, 0) + 1, updated_at = #{accessTime} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = false
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM workflow_variables WHERE workflow_id = #{workflowId} AND deleted = false ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM workflow_variables WHERE execution_id = #{executionId} AND deleted = false ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM workflow_variables WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND deleted = false ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM workflow_variables WHERE node_id = #{nodeId} AND deleted = false ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE workflow_variables SET deleted = true, updated_at = NOW() WHERE workflow_id = #{workflowId} AND deleted = false
UPDATE workflow_variables SET deleted = true, updated_at = NOW() WHERE execution_id = #{executionId} AND deleted = false
UPDATE workflow_variables SET deleted = true, updated_at = NOW() WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND deleted = false
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) as total_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN scope = 'GLOBAL' THEN 1 END) as global_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN scope = 'WORKFLOW' THEN 1 END) as workflow_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN scope = 'EXECUTION' THEN 1 END) as execution_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN scope = 'SESSION' THEN 1 END) as session_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN scope = 'NODE' THEN 1 END) as node_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN type = 'STRING' THEN 1 END) as string_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN type = 'NUMBER' THEN 1 END) as number_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN type = 'BOOLEAN' THEN 1 END) as boolean_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN type = 'OBJECT' THEN 1 END) as object_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN type = 'ARRAY' THEN 1 END) as array_count FROM workflow_variables WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = false
